Notes

GEMETSTA was discontinued in 2004 May CPS. Therefore cases with [HRMONTH > 4 AND HRYEAR4 = 2004] will have missing values of GEMETSTA. GEMETSTA is based on MSA definitions from the 1990 Decennial Census and is not comparable to GTMETSTA. Files: ATUS-CPS File, Activity Summary File (the dictionary's File column).
